description: Processing Supervisor (Dyeing and Printing) is responsible for monitoring production, quality and smooth operation of processes beginning with development of recipe to execution of processes with junior management cadres working as a team. Processing supervisors strategize efficient techniques to maximize the productivity and performance of the staff. He also ensures discharge of effluents as per defined statutory norms.
awardingBodyName: Apparel Madeups and Home Furnishings Sector Skill Council
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Maintain health, safety and security in the processing department with Gender and PwD Sensitization
Supervise the process of dyeing and printing as per plan received from production planning
Develop recipe for dyeing and printing as per the customer requirement or pantone shade
Plan and organize materials to be dyed and printed as per customer requirements and dyes and chemicals
Adhere to industry, regulatory, and organizational standards and embrace environmentally sustainable practices
Ensure workplace orderliness and efficiently operate tools and machinery

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant Qualification of NSQF Level 4
